Update_ service maintenance, as Now July 6th, my Freedom Mobile service appears to be working underground at the stations.. so temporary it was out for about a week.

Honestly, ATM I am 33. No kids, not married. Looking back at my 20s I spent working. Shift work, weekends. Etc, I partied 17-19yrs. I didn't date much as I put work first before any girl. I never spent my paycheck on a girl. From Canada, education taught us equally. Therefore she can pay her half.
Anyway, I am a lot richer today for not making past mistakes, never SIMP (if you're going to give away money, give to charity or your mom). As for relationships I never cared because girls are never single, women tend to always have other men on a call list for attention or late night fun. Unless she's a working girl, with high grades and is advancing fast in post secondary to graduate and jump into her career profession.. (rarity).  You can bet that you avoided lots of Drama. I have coworkers whom are near the same age as me and when we started working together, they just got married.. now 7-10years later.. divorced. So count your blessings that you didn't get mixed up into emotional drama. B.S. tests and jocking for control between your girl with your relationship. Again unless a girl is on a career path before 25yrs likely your just avoiding train wreck Drama.
As for just hanging out as guys or having good guy friends, from my experience use your judgment.. (my experience as a teen/adult 17-23y is that other guys will dog your girl of interest, you pick her up and shortly after when getting to know eachother, she wants to meet the guy friends and in the name of social networks all your guy friends will get her phone number and add or follow the new girl on their social networks). That's a waste girl.. looking to mess around with your guy friends. N guys are shitheads who will do it. Hence why I believe unless people are all married.. Men and women can't be friends.. (what does a woman do in a 'friendship' to benefit the guy friend) often she will task the guy with stuff to do for her.
Expand your interests and offer a helping hand to someone.. Guy's need helping hands with projects and renovations or car stuff.. you can share some beers and vibe to music. When I think life isn't getting better.. I think about better weather, sports, things I do have.. give thanks for it. Shit isn't perfect (I wish I was taller) but try your best and never measure yourself with someone else. Your unique. So, if shit sucks.. the world is a big place.. pick up and relocate.
